title: Sliding window: shrink loop
summary: Longest substring with at most k distinct characters. Add text[right]; while the window breaks the rule, remove text[left] and step left. O(n).
code: # Grow on the right; shrink from the left until the window is valid again.
triggers: longest or shortest window whose count-based rule can break and be restored
'at most k distinct', 'at most k replacements', 'contains every required character'
prompts: A sensor stream tags each reading with a device id. Find the longest run of consecutive readings that involves at most two devices.
Books on a shelf are in arrival order. What is the longest run of neighbouring books that spans at most three genres?
invariant: After the while loop, text[left:right + 1] has at most k distinct characters and counts holds exactly its character counts.
mantra: Expand to explore, shrink to restore.
pitfalls: Delete a character when its count reaches 0, or len(counts) never drops.
For longest-window problems 'if' instead of 'while' still passes (the window slides at its best size); minimum-window problems need the 'while'.
Update best after the shrink, once the window is valid again.
